# Backend Module Scaffold

Creates new NestJS feature modules following the established MoneyFlow backend conventions. See `AGENTS.md` for architectural overview.

## Conventions (must follow)

| Concern | Rule |
|---------|------|
| **Auth guard** | `JwtAuthGuard` is global via `APP_GUARD`. All routes require JWT. Add `@Public()` decorator to opt-out individual routes. |
| **Current user** | Use `@CurrentUser()` custom decorator to get the authenticated `User` entity. Import from `../auth/current-user.decorator`. |
| **ORM** | TypeORM 0.3. Inject repos via `@InjectRepository(Entity) private repo: Repository<Entity>`. |
| **DTOs** | Use `class-validator` decorators (`@IsString()`, `@IsEmail()`, `@IsOptional()`, etc.). Separately define `CreateXDto` and `UpdateXDto` — do NOT extend create DTO for update (fields may be optional). |
| **Validation** | Global `ValidationPipe` handles transform and whitelist. No per-controller pipe needed. |
| **Module pattern** | `*.module.ts`, `*.controller.ts`, `*.service.ts`, `*.entity.ts`, `dto/*.dto.ts`. Controller routes are kebab-case (e.g., `@Controller('new-feature')`). |
| **UUID params** | Use `@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string`. |
| **Errors** | Throw NestJS exceptions: `NotFoundException`, `BadRequestException`, `UnauthorizedException`. |
| **ID generation** | UUID generated by PostgreSQL `gen_random_uuid()`. Entity uses `@PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')`. |
| **Strict null** | `strictNullChecks: false` — nullable columns are `null` types, no `!` assertions needed. |

## File checklist

For a new module `new-feature`:

```
backend/src/modules/new-feature/
├── new-feature.entity.ts       ← TypeORM entity
├── dto/
│   └── new-feature.dto.ts      ← Create & Update DTOs
├── new-feature.service.ts      ← Business logic
├── new-feature.controller.ts   ← Routes
└── new-feature.module.ts       ← Module registration
```

Plus register in `backend/src/app.module.ts`.

## Templates

### Entity (`new-feature.entity.ts`)

```ts
import { Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column, CreateDateColumn, ManyToOne, JoinColumn } from 'typeorm';
import { User } from '../users/user.entity';

@Entity('new_features')
export class NewFeature {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;

  @Column({ name: 'user_id' })
  userId: string;

  @Column({ length: 100 })
  name: string;

  @CreateDateColumn({ name: 'created_at' })
  createdAt: Date;

  @ManyToOne(() => User)
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'user_id' })
  user: User;
}
```

### DTO (`dto/new-feature.dto.ts`)

```ts
import { IsString, MaxLength, IsOptional } from 'class-validator';

export class CreateNewFeatureDto {
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(100)
  name: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  note?: string;
}

export class UpdateNewFeatureDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(100)
  name?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  note?: string;
}
```

### Service (`new-feature.service.ts`)

```ts
import { Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { NewFeature } from './new-feature.entity';
import { CreateNewFeatureDto, UpdateNewFeatureDto } from './dto/new-feature.dto';

@Injectable()
export class NewFeatureService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(NewFeature)
    private readonly repo: Repository<NewFeature>,
  ) {}

  findAll(userId: string): Promise<NewFeature[]> {
    return this.repo.find({ where: { userId }, order: { createdAt: 'DESC' } });
  }

  async findOne(id: string, userId: string): Promise<NewFeature> {
    const entity = await this.repo.findOne({ where: { id, userId } });
    if (!entity) throw new NotFoundException(`NewFeature ${id} not found`);
    return entity;
  }

  create(dto: CreateNewFeatureDto, userId: string): Promise<NewFeature> {
    const entity = this.repo.create({ ...dto, userId });
    return this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateNewFeatureDto, userId: string): Promise<NewFeature> {
    const entity = await this.findOne(id, userId);
    Object.assign(entity, dto);
    return this.repo.save(entity);
  }

  async remove(id: string, userId: string): Promise<void> {
    const entity = await this.findOne(id, userId);
    await this.repo.remove(entity);
  }
}
```

### Controller (`new-feature.controller.ts`)

```ts
import { Controller, Get, Post, Patch, Delete, Param, Body, ParseUUIDPipe, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { CurrentUser } from '../auth/current-user.decorator';
import { User } from '../users/user.entity';
import { NewFeatureService } from './new-feature.service';
import { CreateNewFeatureDto, UpdateNewFeatureDto } from './dto/new-feature.dto';

@Controller('new-feature')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
export class NewFeatureController {
  constructor(private readonly service: NewFeatureService) {}

  @Get()
  findAll(@CurrentUser() user: User) {
    return this.service.findAll(user.id);
  }

  @Post()
  create(@Body() dto: CreateNewFeatureDto, @CurrentUser() user: User) {
    return this.service.create(dto, user.id);
  }

  @Patch(':id')
  update(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Body() dto: UpdateNewFeatureDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: User,
  ) {
    return this.service.update(id, dto, user.id);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  remove(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @CurrentUser() user: User) {
    return this.service.remove(id, user.id);
  }
}
```

### Module (`new-feature.module.ts`)

```ts
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { NewFeature } from './new-feature.entity';
import { NewFeatureService } from './new-feature.service';
import { NewFeatureController } from './new-feature.controller';

@Module({
  imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([NewFeature])],
  providers: [NewFeatureService],
  controllers: [NewFeatureController],
  exports: [NewFeatureService],
})
export class NewFeatureModule {}
```

### Register in `app.module.ts`

Add to the `imports` array of `AppModule`:

```ts
import { NewFeatureModule } from './modules/new-feature/new-feature.module';
```

### DB migration (if needed)

Add idempotent SQL to `database/init/` with the next number prefix. Use `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, and `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS`.
